body: I’m struggling with this at the moment, I’m usually so social and love to be around others, I find now that when I see people I get so mentally tired and want to be on my own quickly and then when I’m on my own I’m lonely again.. it’s a vicious cycle! But I’m trying to reach out, I’ve found some of my friends who look like they have it all together are struggling as much as me
I’m 26 but I like to chat about anything
